name: Roßkogelhütte
kurzbeschreibung: **Roßkogel Hut** in **Oberperfuß** – a cozy mountain refuge nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short hike from the charming village. Enjoy breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps**, hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Käsespätzle**, and a warm welcome in this rustic alpine retreat. Perfect for hikers, nature lovers, and those seeking a taste of authentic mountain life.
